executive_summary: The BOR Fiscal Committee meeting on July 27, 2026, focused on several key fiscal matters, including agreements and appropriations related to city projects and services. The committee approved additional appropriations for the Youth Services Bureau and state-certified fire training programs. Discussions also included the rejection of capital project closeouts and the approval of funding for the Yerwood Center renovations. An executive session was held to discuss the municipal tax services program, resulting in a suggestion to pursue an RFP with capital tax services.

key_topics.topic: Approval of Agreement with Graviton Consulting Services
key_topics.summary: The committee discussed the approval of an agreement with Graviton Consulting Services for ERP program support, but no motion was made.

key_topics.topic: Approval of Contract with Forum Consulting Services
key_topics.summary: The committee reviewed a contract with Forum Consulting Services for staffing information security analysts, but no action was taken.
The committee approved an additional appropriation of $50,000 for the Mayor's Youth Employment Program.
An additional appropriation of $57,054 was approved for fire training and professional development programs.
The committee planned to discuss the municipal tax services program but postponed due to absent participants.
The committee discussed and approved funding for the Yerwood Center renovations, including reallocating ARP funds.
